Record Type: Zoning Certificate Class I Home Occupation
Description: Good Ancestors is a small mission-driven design and strategy studio. The business conducts research, develops materials, and provides design, planning, and strategic consulting services for climate tech startups, digital agencies, and self-initiated projects. Work primarily involves computer-based activities such as ux design, development, visual design, virtual meetings, and coordination with collaborators. The business operates as a quiet professional office with minimal on-site activity. Most collaboration occurs remotely via video calls and digital communication. There is no retail component, manufacturing, equipment use, or regular client traffic. Occasional small meetings may occur, but day-to-day operations consist of standard desk-based work similar to a home office or small professional studio.
